description:
Advances: ancora.tasks

Problem

`mix spec.check --spec-dir <dir>` is a documented flag (must: ancora.tasks.check_flags), and after ancora-xla.3 the gate honors it for base-tree materialization and index building. But Ancora.Gate.Preflight.corpus/1 at lib/ancora/gate/preflight.ex:57-62 still hardcodes `File.dir?(root <> "/.spec")` and returns the env error "no .spec/ directory in <root>; run mix spec.init" regardless of --spec-dir. A project whose specs live only under docs/spec cannot start a gate run at all unless an empty decoy `.spec/` directory is present. Found by the ancora-xla.3 verifier and confirmed by its auditor on 2026-09-03; both had to write an untracked `.spec/.keep` into their fixtures to get past preflight, and that ticket's own new test at test/ancora/gate_test.exs:226 does the same.

Why it is not in ancora-xla.3

preflight.ex is outside that ticket's Allowed touches and untouched by it, and the fix has to decide what the corpus wildcards and the `mix spec.init` remedy message should do under a configured directory. The auditor ruled it a follow-up rather than a widening.

Expected

Preflight resolves the same spec dir the gate uses (Keyword.get(opts, :spec_dir) || ".spec") and checks for that directory; the remedy message names the configured path. A tagged test under ancora.tasks.check_flags runs the real CLI on a fixture whose specs live only under docs/spec with NO .spec/ present and gets a report, not tier=env.

Allowed touches (this ticket may modify):
- lib/ancora/gate/preflight.ex, lib/ancora/gate.ex (spec_dir plumbing only)
- test/ancora/gate_test.exs, test/mix/tasks/spec_check_test.exs, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.tasks.spec.md and .spec/specs/ancora.gate.spec.md (acknowledgment edits only), .spec/decisions/**
- Any .spec/specs/<subject>.spec.md that spec.check names in a derived/drift, growth or shrink finding caused by this ticket's own diff (acknowledgment edits only, substantive from that subject's point of view)

Out of Scope (files): lib/ancora/derive/**, lib/ancora/review/**, lib/mix/tasks/** beyond flag plumbing
Out of Scope (intent): no change to the default spec dir; no change to scaffold output

Verification
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix format --check-formatted && mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.check --base <base> ends result=pass
- [ ] Real CLI run on a fixture with specs only under docs/spec and no .spec/ returns a report

Origin: ancora-xla.3 grading, 2026-09-03. Standalone; not adopted into ancora-xla. Adopting it is Manuel's call.
title: Preflight ignores the configured spec dir: a gate run cannot start without an empty .spec/ present
